A Deployment treats pods as interchangeable: any pod can be replaced or scaled freely, with random names and shared or no storage. A StatefulSet gives each pod a stable identity (ordinal name and stable DNS), its own persistent volume that follows it, and ordered start, stop and rolling updates. Pick it when each replica needs its own identity or data, such as databases, Kafka or ZooKeeper-style clustered systems; otherwise use a Deployment.
Action: none, just the explanation; I can look at which of your workloads would need which.

`structuredClone` preserves Dates, Maps, Sets, typed arrays, undefined and cycles; the JSON round trip turns Dates into strings, Maps/Sets into `{}`, drops undefined and functions, and throws on circular references.
